title: Lead Client Partner, Global Accounts
description:

 Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

 Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here .

title: Working Student Sales Operations (f/m/d)
description:
Mission Plan  

We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Operations Working Student to support the Isar Aerospace commercial team, including Sales, Marketing, and Communications. The working student will serve as an active contributor to sales proposal development, deals, and marketing activities and events through the development, training, and optimization of AI-powered platforms, agents and automation solutions, both generative and agentic. This position is ideal for students interested in sales operations, artificial intelligence, business analytics, prompt engineering, process automation, and UI design. 

The working student will work closely with Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, and Cross-Functional Teams to help design AI-driven workflows that improve productivity, sales insights, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational efficiency, creating a lean ecosystem. 

This role provides hands-on exposure to modern AI technologies, data analysis, CRM & CLM systems, and enterprise sales processes.

title: (Senior) GNC Engineer - Navigation, Flight Software (m/f/d)
description:
Mission Brief 

As a GNC Engineer at Isar Aerospace SE, you develop the guidance, navigation, and control systems that enable Spectrum to operate safely, accurately, and efficiently throughout its mission. You design, verify, and validate flight algorithms that determine the vehicle’s position, velocity, and attitude while steering it along its optimal trajectory during all phases of flight. By combining flight dynamics, state estimation, control theory, and high-fidelity simulation, you ensure robust performance in the presence of uncertainties and disturbances. Your work is essential to maximizing mission success, payload capability, and the reliability of every Spectrum launch. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Architect the next generation navigation system for an orbital launch vehicle

title: Director Marketing & Branding (f/m/d)
description:
Mission Brief 

Isar Aerospace is entering an exciting new growth phase, advancing to the delivery of commercial launch services for institutional, governmental, and commercial customers worldwide. 

We are seeking a strategic and hands-on Director Marketing & Branding to lead the company's marketing and brand function, supporting business growth, customer acquisition, and market positioning. Working closely with Sales, Government Relations, Product, and the Executive Leadership Team, you will develop and execute marketing strategies that strengthen Isar Aerospace's brand, generate demand, and accelerate commercial success in the European and international space sector. 

Leading a compact, high-performing team, you will combine strategic thinking with operational excellence to build marketing capabilities that scale alongside the company's growth ambitions. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

Brand Strategy & Positioning 

  • Develop and continuously refine Isar Aerospace's brand strategy and positioning, ensuring alignment with the company's Mission, Vision, and Strategy. 
  • Own and evolve the company's brand architecture, identity, messaging framework, and visual presence across all touchpoints. 
  • Ensure consistent brand application throughout customer-facing channels, materials, events, and campaigns.
